items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: I don't know Bud Scott the guitar player. I'm up hood of him, but I don't know him.

ctx.x: And, uh, to Bud Scott the guitar player, where was he from?
I don't know Bud Scott the guitar player. I'm up hood of him, but I don't know him.
That's always been confusing. I mean, that's news.
